changes.requirementName: A question page names the part of the notification it belongs to, above its heading
changes.before:
### Requirement: A question page names the part of the notification it belongs to, above its heading
**ID**: REQ-CAPTIONS-001
The system MUST show, above the heading of a question page, the name of the part of the notification that page belongs to. The parts named MUST be: About the consignment, Commodity details, Consignment parties, Movement, Transport and arrival, Add a new transporter, and Documents.

#### Scenario: A question page is captioned with the part it belongs to
**ID**: SCN-CAPTIONS-001-A
- **GIVEN** the user is on a question page that belongs to a part of the notification
- **WHEN** the page is shown
- **THEN** the name of that part is shown immediately above the page's heading

#### Scenario: Every page of a part carries the same caption
**ID**: SCN-CAPTIONS-001-B
- **GIVEN** two question pages that belong to the same part of the notification
- **WHEN** the user visits each in turn
- **THEN** both are captioned with that part's name
changes.after:

- **THEN** the name of that part is shown immediately above the page's heading

**ID**: SCN-CAPTIONS-001-B
- **GIVEN** two question pages that belong to the same part of the notification

changes.summary: "Description of the goods" is added to the list of captions. The commodity details page now carries it above its heading.

changes.requirementName: The navigation offers the same five items throughout the service
changes.before:
### Requirement: The navigation offers the same four items throughout the service
**ID**: REQ-NAV-001
The system MUST offer four items in the service navigation on every page: a link to the dashboard, a link to the address book, an option to manage the account, and a way to sign out.

#### Scenario: The navigation lists its four items on the dashboard
**ID**: SCN-NAV-001-A
- **GIVEN** the user is signed in
- **WHEN** they view the dashboard
- **THEN** the navigation offers a link to the dashboard, a link to the address book, an option to manage the account, and a way to sign out
changes.after:
### Requirement: The navigation offers the same five items throughout the service
**ID**: REQ-NAV-001
The system MUST offer five items in the service navigation on every page a signed-in user sees, in this order: Dashboard, Templates, Address book, Manage account and Log out, and MUST offer none to a visitor who is not signed in.

#### Scenario: The navigation lists its five items on the dashboard
**ID**: SCN-NAV-001-A
- **GIVEN** the user is signed in
- **WHEN** they view the dashboard
- **THEN** the navigation offers, in order, Dashboard, Templates, Address book, Manage account and Log out

#### Scenario: A visitor who is not signed in is offered no navigation items
**ID**: SCN-NAV-001-B
- **GIVEN** the visitor is not signed in
- **WHEN** a page of the service is shown
- **THEN** the service name is shown
- **AND** no navigation item is offered
changes.summary: The navigation grows from four items to five, with Templates added second. A visitor who is not signed in now sees no navigation items.

changes.requirementName: The navigation marks Templates as the current section on every templates page
changes.after:
### Requirement: The navigation marks Templates as the current section on every templates page
**ID**: REQ-NAV-004
The system MUST mark the Templates item as the current section on Manage templates and every page under it, and MUST NOT mark Dashboard or Address book there; elsewhere Templates MUST NOT be marked.

#### Scenario: Templates is marked current on Manage templates
**ID**: SCN-NAV-004-A
- **GIVEN** the user is signed in
- **WHEN** they open Manage templates
- **THEN** Templates is marked as the current section
- **AND** neither Dashboard nor Address book is marked

#### Scenario: Templates is not marked current on the dashboard
**ID**: SCN-NAV-004-B
- **GIVEN** the user is on the dashboard
- **WHEN** they view the navigation
- **THEN** Dashboard is marked as the current section
- **AND** Templates is not

#### Scenario: Templates is marked current while creating a template
**ID**: SCN-NAV-004-C
- **GIVEN** the user is creating a template
- **WHEN** the template name page or "Origin of the import" for the template is shown
- **THEN** Templates is marked as the current section
- **AND** Dashboard is not
changes.summary: New. Templates is highlighted as the current section on Manage templates and on every page for creating a template.

changes.requirementName: The Templates item opens Manage templates
changes.after:
### Requirement: The Templates item opens Manage templates
**ID**: REQ-NAV-005
The system MUST open the Manage templates page when the user follows the Templates item.

#### Scenario: Following Templates opens Manage templates
**ID**: SCN-NAV-005-A
- **GIVEN** the user is signed in
- **WHEN** they follow Templates in the navigation
- **THEN** the page headed "Manage templates" is shown
changes.summary: New. The Templates item takes the user to the Manage templates page.

changes.requirementName: The Address book item opens the Import Notification Service address book
changes.after:
### Requirement: The Address book item opens the Import Notification Service address book
**ID**: REQ-NAV-006
The system MUST open the Import Notification Service's address book when the user follows the Address book item.

#### Scenario: Following Address book opens the INS address book
**ID**: SCN-NAV-006-A
- **GIVEN** the user is signed in and on the live animals dashboard
- **WHEN** they follow Address book in the navigation
- **AND** they complete sign-in to the Import Notification Service if it asks
- **THEN** the Import Notification Service address book is shown
changes.summary: New. The Address book item opens the address book in the Import Notification Service, signing the user in there if it asks.

changes.requirementName: Overview groups the notification's tasks under six fixed, numbered sections
changes.before:
### Requirement: Overview groups the notification's tasks under six fixed, numbered sections
**ID**: REQ-OVERVIEW-001
The system MUST group the notification's tasks on the Overview page under six numbered section headings, in a fixed order, with one task list per section.

#### Scenario: A fresh notification's Overview lists its always-present tasks under the six sections
**ID**: SCN-OVERVIEW-001-A
- **GIVEN** a new notification has just been started
- **WHEN** the user views Overview
- **THEN** it shows six numbered section headings in order: "1. About the consignment", "2. Description of the goods", "3. Transport and arrival", "4. Documents", "5. Consignment parties", "6. Contact address"
- **AND** each section lists that notification's always-present tasks (for example, "Where is this consignment coming from?" and "What are you importing?" under the first section)
changes.after:
### Requirement: Overview groups the notification's tasks under six fixed, numbered sections
**ID**: REQ-OVERVIEW-001
For a notification, the system MUST group its tasks on the Overview page under six numbered section headings, in a fixed order, with one task list per section.

#### Scenario: A fresh notification's Overview lists its always-present tasks under the six sections
**ID**: SCN-OVERVIEW-001-A
- **GIVEN** a new notification has just been started
- **WHEN** the user views Overview
- **THEN** it shows six numbered section headings in order: "1. About the consignment", "2. Description of the goods", "3. Transport and arrival", "4. Documents", "5. Consignment parties", "6. Contact address"
- **AND** each section lists that notification's always-present tasks (for example, "Where is this consignment coming from?" and "What are you importing?" under the first section)
changes.summary: The rule now applies to a notification only. While a template is being created, the page is the template's task list.

changes.requirementName: Each task row shows one of two statuses, and Overview offers a review button open at any point
changes.before:
### Requirement: Each task row shows one of two statuses, and Overview offers a review button open at any point
**ID**: REQ-OVERVIEW-002
The system MUST show each task row's status as one of two labels — Complete once it is answered, To do otherwise, never a third or blocked state — and MUST offer a fixed "Review and submit" button, not a task row, that opens the review page at any point in the journey however much of the notification remains outstanding.

#### Scenario: A fresh notification shows an answered task as Complete and an unworked task as To do, both linked
**ID**: SCN-OVERVIEW-002-A
- **GIVEN** a new notification whose entry page has been answered but nothing else
- **WHEN** the user views Overview
- **THEN** the entry task's row shows Complete, with a link
- **AND** a task not yet worked on shows To do, with a link to begin it

#### Scenario: The Review and submit button opens the review before every task is answered
**ID**: SCN-OVERVIEW-002-B
- **GIVEN** a notification with only its entry page answered
- **WHEN** the user views Overview
- **THEN** a "Review and submit" button is offered, not a task row, with no cannot-start-yet state shown anywhere on the page
- **AND** following it opens the review page
changes.after:
### Requirement: Each task row shows one of two statuses, and Overview offers a review button open at any point

#### Scenario: A fresh notification shows an answered task as Complete and an unworked task as To do, both linked
**ID**: SCN-OVERVIEW-002-A

- **WHEN** the user views Overview
- **THEN** the entry task's row shows Complete, with a link
- **AND** a task not yet worked on shows To do, with a link to begin it

#### Scenario: The Review and submit button opens the review before every task is answered

- **GIVEN** a notification with only its entry page answered
- **WHEN** the user views Overview
- **THEN** a "Review and submit" button is offered, not a task row, with no cannot-start-yet state shown anywhere on the page
- **AND** following it opens the review page
changes.summary: The rule now applies to a notification only. A template's task list follows its own rules.

changes.requirementName: Overview's only route off the page is the Return to dashboard action — there is no back link
changes.before:
### Requirement: Overview's only route off the page is the Return to dashboard action — there is no back link
**ID**: REQ-OVERVIEW-003
The system MUST offer a return-to-dashboard action from Overview and take the user to the dashboard, and MUST NOT show a back link, since Overview is the top of the notification rather than a step within it.

#### Scenario: The return action leads to the dashboard, with no back link present
**ID**: SCN-OVERVIEW-003-A
- **GIVEN** the user is on Overview
- **WHEN** they view the page
- **THEN** no back link is shown
- **WHEN** they use the return-to-dashboard action
- **THEN** they arrive at the dashboard

changes.requirementName: Main import reason completes on the reason's own answers, apart from Additional details
changes.after:
### Requirement: Main import reason completes on the reason's own answers, apart from Additional details
**ID**: REQ-OVERVIEW-008
The system MUST mark the Main import reason task Complete once an allowed reason and the questions it opens are saved — Internal market with a purpose; Transhipment or onward travel with a destination country; Transit with a port of exit and a destination country; Temporary admission horses with an exit date and a port of exit; Re-entry alone — whether or not Additional details is answered, and MUST NOT mark it Complete while no reason is saved.

#### Scenario: The reason task completes while Additional details is still to do
**ID**: SCN-OVERVIEW-008-A
- **GIVEN** an allowed reason and its questions are saved and Additional details is unanswered
- **WHEN** the user views Overview
- **THEN** Main import reason reads Complete
- **AND** Additional details reads To do

#### Scenario: The reason task is not complete with no reason saved
**ID**: SCN-OVERVIEW-008-B
- **GIVEN** no reason is saved
- **WHEN** the user views Overview
- **THEN** Main import reason reads To do
changes.summary: New. Main import reason now shows Complete once the reason and its follow-up questions are saved, even if Additional details is still to do.

changes.requirementName: Where is this consignment coming from? completes only once the country and the region code question are answered
changes.after:
### Requirement: Where is this consignment coming from? completes only once the country and the region code question are answered
**ID**: REQ-OVERVIEW-009
The system MUST mark the "Where is this consignment coming from?" task Complete only once a country is chosen and the region of origin code question is answered, with a code given when the answer is Yes, and MUST NOT mark it Complete while either is missing.

#### Scenario: A country with the region question unanswered is not complete
**ID**: SCN-OVERVIEW-009-A
- **GIVEN** a country is saved and the region of origin code question is unanswered
- **WHEN** the user views Overview
- **THEN** "Where is this consignment coming from?" does not read Complete

#### Scenario: A country with No is complete
**ID**: SCN-OVERVIEW-009-B
- **GIVEN** a country is saved and the answer is that no region code is required
- **WHEN** the user views Overview
- **THEN** "Where is this consignment coming from?" reads Complete

#### Scenario: A country with Yes and a code is complete
**ID**: SCN-OVERVIEW-009-C
- **GIVEN** a country is saved, a region code is required and the code is given
- **WHEN** the user views Overview
- **THEN** "Where is this consignment coming from?" reads Complete
changes.summary:
New. The origin task shows Complete only when a country is chosen and the region code question is answered.

If the answer is Yes, a code is needed too.

changes.requirementName: Overview marks its commodity summary, the task list and each numbered section as named regions
changes.after:
### Requirement: Overview marks its commodity summary, the task list and each numbered section as named regions
**ID**: REQ-OVERVIEW-010
For a notification, the system MUST mark the "Your commodities" block, the task list and each numbered section on Overview as regions named by their own heading, MUST mark the animals total card as a region named "Animals summary" and the packages total card as one named "Packages summary", and MUST keep each task link describing its status, and Roles and addresses its hint, to assistive technology.

#### Scenario: The two total cards are named regions
**ID**: SCN-OVERVIEW-010-A
- **GIVEN** a new notification has just been started
- **WHEN** the user views Overview
- **THEN** the animals total sits in a region named "Animals summary" and the packages total in one named "Packages summary"
- **AND** both are inside the "Your commodities" region

#### Scenario: The task list and each section are regions named by their heading
**ID**: SCN-OVERVIEW-010-B
- **GIVEN** a new notification has just been started
- **WHEN** the user views Overview
- **THEN** the task list is a region named "Notification tasklist"
- **AND** each of the six numbered sections inside it is a region named by its heading, for example "1. About the consignment"

#### Scenario: A task link carries its status, and Roles and addresses its hint
**ID**: SCN-OVERVIEW-010-C
- **GIVEN** a new notification has just been started
- **WHEN** assistive technology reads a task link
- **THEN** it describes the link with the task's status
- **AND** the Roles and addresses link is described by its hint and then its status
changes.summary: New. Overview is split into named regions so screen reader users can move around it by section.

changes.requirementName: The third task of About the consignment is Main import reason
changes.after:
### Requirement: The third task of About the consignment is Main import reason
**ID**: REQ-OVERVIEW-011
The system MUST title the third task of "1. About the consignment" "Main import reason" and MUST NOT show "Main reason for import" on Overview.

#### Scenario: The first section lists Main import reason third
**ID**: SCN-OVERVIEW-011-A
- **GIVEN** a new notification has just been started
- **WHEN** the user views Overview
- **THEN** "1. About the consignment" lists "Where is this consignment coming from?", "What are you importing?" and "Main import reason", in that order
- **AND** "Main reason for import" does not appear
changes.summary:
New. The third task in the first section is titled "Main import reason".

The words "Main reason for import" must not appear on Overview.

changes.requirementName: The Transit countries task appears only when transit countries are owed, between Arrival details and Transport details
changes.after:
### Requirement: The Transit countries task appears only when transit countries are owed, between Arrival details and Transport details
**ID**: REQ-OVERVIEW-012
The system MUST show the "Transit countries" task in "3. Transport and arrival" only once a commodity is chosen and the saved means of transport is Rail or Road, MUST list it after "Arrival details" and before "Transport details", and MUST show it To do until at least one transit country is saved, then Complete.

#### Scenario: No commodity chosen means no Transit countries task
**ID**: SCN-OVERVIEW-012-A
- **GIVEN** no commodity is chosen and arrival details are saved with Road
- **WHEN** the user views Overview
- **THEN** no "Transit countries" task is shown
- **AND** the third section lists "Arrival details" then "Transport details"

#### Scenario: A chosen commodity travelling by rail or road shows the task in its place
**ID**: SCN-OVERVIEW-012-B
- **GIVEN** a commodity is chosen and Rail or Road is saved as the means of transport
- **WHEN** the user views Overview
- **THEN** the third section lists "Arrival details", "Transit countries" and "Transport details", in that order
- **AND** "Transit countries" reads To do

#### Scenario: The task completes once a country is saved
**ID**: SCN-OVERVIEW-012-C
- **GIVEN** a commodity is chosen, Rail or Road is saved and no transit country is saved
- **WHEN** the user saves at least one transit country and views Overview
- **THEN** "Transit countries" reads Complete

#### Scenario: A consignment travelling by air has no Transit countries task
**ID**: SCN-OVERVIEW-012-D
- **GIVEN** a cat is chosen
- **WHEN** the user views Overview before arrival details are saved, and again after Air is saved
- **THEN** no "Transit countries" task is shown
changes.summary: New. A Transit countries task appears on Overview only for rail or road, and reads To do until a country is saved.

changes.requirementName: Arrival details stops reading Complete once its saved arrival date is more than 7 days in the past
changes.after:
### Requirement: Arrival details stops reading Complete once its saved arrival date is more than 7 days in the past
**ID**: REQ-OVERVIEW-013
The system MUST measure a saved arrival date against the allowed arrival window each time Overview is viewed, and MUST show "Arrival details" as To do once that date is more than 7 days in the past, however completely the task was answered when it was saved.

#### Scenario: A saved arrival date more than 7 days in the past reads To do
**ID**: SCN-OVERVIEW-013-A
- **GIVEN** arrival details were saved complete, and the saved arrival date is now more than 7 days in the past
- **WHEN** the user views Overview
- **THEN** "Arrival details" reads To do

#### Scenario: A saved arrival date exactly 7 days in the past still reads Complete
**ID**: SCN-OVERVIEW-013-B
- **GIVEN** arrival details were saved complete, and the saved arrival date is exactly 7 days in the past
- **WHEN** the user views Overview
- **THEN** "Arrival details" reads Complete
changes.summary: New. Arrival details goes back to To do once the saved arrival date is more than 7 days in the past.

changes.requirementName: The journey is ordered as ten sections, each a sequence of pages
changes.before:
### Requirement: The journey is ordered as ten sections, each a sequence of pages
**ID**: REQ-FLOW-001
The system MUST order the journey as ten sections, and MUST offer each section's pages in a fixed sequence.

#### Scenario: The journey's sections run in a fixed order
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-001-A
- **GIVEN** a notification is being worked on
- **WHEN** its sections are followed from the start
- **THEN** they run in this order: the dashboard; origin of the import; what are you importing and commodity details; identification details; import reason and additional details; upload documents; consignment addresses and County Parish Holding; the transport pages; contact address; and finally check your answers, declaration and confirmation

#### Scenario: The transport section sequences its pages in order
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-001-B
- **GIVEN** a user is working through the transport section
- **WHEN** they continue from each page in turn
- **THEN** they are offered arrival details, transited countries and the combined transporter list, in that order, skipping any that is not in scope
- **AND** the transporter type question and the two type-specific forms are not offered as steps of this section — they are reached only via "Add a transporter" from the combined list
changes.after:
### Requirement: The journey is ordered as ten sections, each a sequence of pages
**ID**: REQ-FLOW-001
The system MUST order the journey as ten sections, and MUST offer each section's pages in a fixed sequence.

#### Scenario: The journey's sections run in a fixed order
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-001-A
- **GIVEN** a notification is being worked on
- **WHEN** its sections are followed from the start
- **THEN** they run in this order: the dashboard; origin of the import; what are you importing, main import reason and commodity details; identification details; additional details; upload documents; the County Parish Holding number and consignment addresses, the first saving back to the second; the transport pages; contact address; and finally check your answers, declaration and confirmation

#### Scenario: The transport section sequences its pages in order
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-001-B
- **GIVEN** a user is working through the transport section in the opening sequence
- **WHEN** they continue from each page in turn
- **THEN** they are offered arrival details, transited countries and the combined transporter list, in that order, skipping any that is not in scope
- **AND** the transporter type question and the two type-specific forms are not offered as steps of this section — they are reached only via "Add a transporter" from the combined list
changes.summary:
The section order changes. Main import reason moves up beside the commodity pages, additional details stands alone, and the CPH number now comes before consignment addresses.

The transport scenario now applies to the opening sequence.

changes.requirementName: Continuing from a page moves on only within its own Overview task, and otherwise returns to Overview
changes.before:
### Requirement: Continuing from any page moves to the next still in scope, and finishing a section returns to Overview
**ID**: REQ-FLOW-003
The system MUST take the user, on continuing from a page, to the next page in that section whose conditions are met, skipping any that are not, and MUST return them to Overview once no page remains in the section.

#### Scenario: Continuing skips a page that is not in scope
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-003-A
- **GIVEN** the user is on a page whose section holds a later page that is not in scope for this notification
- **WHEN** they save and continue
- **THEN** they are taken past the page that is not in scope, to the next one that is

#### Scenario: Finishing the last page of a section returns to Overview
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-003-B
- **GIVEN** the user is on the last page of a section that is still in scope
- **WHEN** they save and continue
- **THEN** they return to Overview rather than continuing into another section
changes.after:
### Requirement: Continuing from a page moves on only within its own Overview task, and otherwise returns to Overview
**ID**: REQ-FLOW-003
The system MUST, outside the opening sequence and outside a change made from check your answers, take the user, on continuing from a page, to the next page of that section that belongs to the same Overview task and whose conditions are met, skipping any that are not, and MUST otherwise return them to Overview — never on into a page another Overview task opens. The system MUST add no marker to a page's address, link or form to tell such a save.

#### Scenario: Continuing moves on only to a later page of the same task
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-003-A
- **GIVEN** the user is on a page whose Overview task holds a later page of the same section — the CPH number page, opened other than from its row
- **WHEN** they save and continue
- **THEN** they are taken to the consignment addresses page, the next page of that task

#### Scenario: Finishing the last page of a section returns to Overview
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-003-B
- **GIVEN** the user is on the last page of a section that is still in scope
- **WHEN** they save and continue
- **THEN** they return to Overview rather than continuing into another section

#### Scenario: A page opened from its Overview task returns to Overview rather than running on into the next task
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-003-C
- **GIVEN** the opening sequence has ended and the user opens what are you importing, main import reason, arrival details or transit countries from its task on Overview
- **WHEN** they save and continue
- **THEN** Overview is shown, not commodity details, additional details, transit countries or the transporter list

#### Scenario: Roles and addresses opened from Overview returns to Overview, even for a consignment that needs a CPH number
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-003-D
- **GIVEN** a consignment that needs a CPH number and roles and addresses opened from its task on Overview
- **WHEN** the user saves and continues
- **THEN** Overview is shown, not the CPH number page

#### Scenario: A page opened from Overview has the same address as in the opening sequence
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-003-E
- **GIVEN** Overview
- **WHEN** the user opens any task
- **THEN** the page's address is the one the opening sequence uses, with nothing added to it or to the link to mark that it came from Overview
- **AND** saving and continuing returns to Overview

#### Scenario: Upload documents keeps its add-another round trip before returning to Overview
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-003-F
- **GIVEN** upload documents opened from Overview
- **WHEN** the user adds a document with "Save and add another"
- **THEN** they stay on upload documents with the document listed
- **WHEN** they save and continue
- **THEN** Overview is shown

#### Scenario: A task saved from Overview reads Complete on return
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-003-G
- **GIVEN** a task opened from Overview
- **WHEN** the user answers it so its answers pass the page's rules and saves and continues
- **THEN** Overview shows that task as Complete

#### Scenario: Commodity details opened from Overview returns to Overview rather than going on to identification details
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-003-H
- **GIVEN** the opening sequence has ended and the user opens commodity details from its task on Overview
- **WHEN** they save and continue
- **THEN** Overview is shown, not identification details

#### Scenario: Main import reason and additional details opened from Overview return to Overview
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-003-I
- **GIVEN** the opening sequence has ended and the user opens main import reason or additional details from its task on Overview
- **WHEN** they save and continue
- **THEN** Overview is shown, not commodity details or arrival details
changes.summary:
Saving a page opened from Overview now returns to Overview, instead of running on into the next page or task.

Pages move on only within the same task, as the CPH number page does to consignment addresses.

changes.requirementName: A page the hub links to directly offers both a discard-and-exit and a save-and-exit route back to Overview
changes.before:
### Requirement: A page the hub links to directly offers both a discard-and-exit and a save-and-exit route back to Overview
**ID**: REQ-FLOW-004
The system MUST let the user leave a page the hub links to directly either by discarding anything typed since it was last saved, or by committing it, and MUST return to Overview either way.

#### Scenario: Cancel and return to overview discards unsaved input
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-004-A
- **GIVEN** the user has typed into a field on a task page without saving

changes.requirementName: Check your answers is open whatever the notification owes; the notification is submitted only once every task row is ready

changes.after:

The block moves to the next step.

Confirming a declaration opened directly goes back to check your answers without submitting.

changes.requirementName: A notification created from the dashboard or the type question runs an opening sequence covering the whole journey, ending on check your answers
changes.before:
### Requirement: A notification created in this session runs an opening sequence covering the whole journey, ending on review
**ID**: REQ-FLOW-007
The system MUST walk a newly created notification through an opening sequence covering every section of the journey, skipping any step not in scope, and MUST deliver the user to the review section once every step is done, or to Overview if a task remains outstanding. This order is the opening sequence's own and MUST NOT be assumed to match the order of the flow sections stated in REQ-FLOW-001.

#### Scenario: A newly created notification is walked through the whole opening sequence to review
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-007-A
- **GIVEN** the user has just created a notification from the dashboard
- **WHEN** they save each page in turn, answering every step
- **THEN** they are taken through every section of the journey in turn
- **AND** they arrive at check your answers once the last step is saved, without returning to Overview partway through

#### Scenario: An opening-sequence step not yet in scope is skipped
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-007-B
- **GIVEN** the user is in the opening sequence and the next step is not yet in scope
- **WHEN** they save the page they are on
- **THEN** they are taken to the next step that is in scope

#### Scenario: Revisiting an opening-sequence page after the run has finished does not resume it
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-007-C
- **GIVEN** the user has already completed the opening sequence for a notification and reached Overview or review
- **WHEN** they open one of the opening sequence's own pages again and save it
- **THEN** they return to Overview, not to whatever would be the next step of the sequence
changes.after:
### Requirement: A notification created from the dashboard or the type question runs an opening sequence covering the whole journey, ending on check your answers
**ID**: REQ-FLOW-007
The system MUST walk a notification created from the dashboard or the Import Notification Service's type question through an opening sequence covering the whole journey, skipping steps not in scope. It MUST NOT offer the CPH number page, MUST go to Overview from roles and addresses when every task is complete, and MUST end on check your answers once the contact address is saved; reaching either ends it. Its order MUST NOT be assumed to match REQ-FLOW-001's sections.

#### Scenario: A newly created notification is walked through the whole opening sequence to review
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-007-A
- **GIVEN** the user has just created a notification from the dashboard
- **WHEN** they save each page in turn, answering every step
- **THEN** they are taken through origin of the import, what are you importing, main import reason, commodity details, identification details, additional details, arrival details, the transporter, upload documents, roles and addresses and the contact address, in that order
- **AND** they arrive at check your answers once the contact address is saved, without returning to Overview partway through

#### Scenario: An opening-sequence step not yet in scope is skipped
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-007-B
- **GIVEN** the user is in the opening sequence and the next step is not yet in scope
- **WHEN** they save the page they are on
- **THEN** they are taken to the next step that is in scope

#### Scenario: Revisiting an opening-sequence page after the run has finished does not resume it
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-007-C
- **GIVEN** the user has already completed the opening sequence for a notification and reached Overview or review
- **WHEN** they open one of the opening sequence's own pages again and save it
- **THEN** they return to Overview, not to whatever would be the next step of the sequence

#### Scenario: The reason for import is asked before the commodity details
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-007-D
- **GIVEN** the user is in the opening sequence on what are you importing
- **WHEN** they save a selection
- **THEN** main import reason is shown
- **WHEN** they save the reason
- **THEN** commodity details is shown

#### Scenario: The CPH number page is never a step of the opening sequence
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-007-E
- **GIVEN** the user is in the opening sequence for a consignment that needs a CPH number
- **WHEN** they save roles and addresses
- **THEN** contact address for this consignment is shown, not the CPH number page

#### Scenario: Roles and addresses goes to Overview when nothing is outstanding
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-007-F
- **GIVEN** the user is in the opening sequence with every task already complete
- **WHEN** they save roles and addresses
- **THEN** Overview is shown

#### Scenario: The opening sequence ends on check your answers even when tasks are outstanding
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-007-G
- **GIVEN** the user is in the opening sequence with tasks outstanding
- **WHEN** they save the contact address
- **THEN** check your answers is shown, naming every unfinished card

#### Scenario: Commodity details goes on to identification details, or to additional details when nothing needs identifying
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-007-H
- **GIVEN** the user is in the opening sequence on commodity details, reached from main import reason
- **WHEN** they save valid counts for a species that needs identifiers
- **THEN** identification details is shown
- **WHEN** instead no chosen species needs identifiers
- **THEN** additional details is shown

#### Scenario: Additional details follows identification details or commodity details, never the main import reason, and goes on to arrival details
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-007-I
- **GIVEN** the user is in the opening sequence
- **WHEN** they save commodity details for a consignment with a species that needs identifiers and then save identification details
- **THEN** additional details is shown
- **WHEN** instead no chosen species needs identifiers and they save commodity details
- **THEN** additional details is shown, without identification details
- **WHEN** they save additional details
- **THEN** arrival details is shown

#### Scenario: Arrival details goes on to transit countries only for rail or road
**ID**: SCN-FLOW-007-J

changes.summary:
The first run now asks for the main import reason before commodity details and skips the CPH number page.

Otherwise it ends on check your answers once the contact address is saved, even with tasks outstanding. It also covers notifications started from the Import Notification Service question.
